correctness.rationale: Coordinate difference c=y-x gives map (x,c)->(x+alpha,c+a/q), whose qth iterate fixes c and irrationally rotates x; each orbit closure consists of q disjoint Haar circles. Disintegration and uniqueness of Haar under qalpha imply every invariant probability is Haar in x times a measure invariant under order-q rotation in c, equivalently mixture over quotient Qq, with extreme coset-Haar joinings. Difference quotient Π is 1-Lipschitz for torus ℓ1 metric, giving Wp lower bound on Qq. Upper bound attained by coupling same x and same j after choosing quotient representatives at minimal circular distance. This works for all p including essential-supremum. Quotient Dirac-to-Haar moment equals 1/[(p+1)(2q)^p], and mixing couples gives sharp radius. Kronecker equidistribution supplies the rationally-independent factor-only comparison. Independent exact quotient-circle moment integrations at multiple p,q checked; proof covers general probabilities via explicit coupling and disintegration.
